collapses.description:
Inputs folded into the plain content slot (columns or image without
their own slot) — shown, but not as authored.

empty.description: Body slots this layout places that the slide has nothing for.

hides.description: Slide inputs this layout shows nowhere.

pptx_zones.description: Whether the layout declares PPTX zones (native editable export).

score.description: Higher fits better; 100 means every input has a home and nothing is empty.
